claim: *Governing consequential work.* The loop that stays constant across domains: people delegate work through a governed environment, remain responsible for the consequential outcome, and use evidence from that outcome to inform subsequent work. Only the outcome's form varies — an artifact that can be inspected, tested, and operated, or a decision whose consequences become observable through subsequent events.
topology: People-to-environment-to-outcome loop; outcome branches into artifact and decision, with observation returning responsibility to people.
required_terms: People responsible\ direction; exercise judgment; accept responsibility
Governed environment\ work possible and safe to delegate
Artifact / system\; circuit; software; process [3pt]Inspected, tested, operated, observed directly
Decision / action\; approval; plan; transaction [3pt]Consequences become observable through subsequent events
Environment examples: models, data, assumptions, standards, policies, tools, agent configurations, review rules, monitoring and controls.
bw_encoding: Responsibility, governed-environment container and outcome container regain separate shades; two outcome forms remain equal alternatives. All strokes and fills are neutral grayscale; labels remain the primary semantic key. Existing dashed meanings are preserved.
redesign: Removed pictograms and decorative gradients. Preserved four environment components, delegated-work channel, contrasting outcome observability, and return-learning loop. Supplemental outcome examples consolidated into the two concrete branches. Grayscale refinement: Responsibility, governed-environment container and outcome container regain separate shades; two outcome forms remain equal alternatives.
